summary: A first look at open generative models for French text-to-speech and for illustrations of school topics, chosen after a desk survey of licences (Apache 2.0 and MIT only). Several open TTS models and three image models (Z-Image-Turbo, FLUX.2 klein 4B as an image editor, Qwen-Image 20B as a GGUF) were run on the pairs with their timings and memory recorded. An audit of the stored images made later found that they do not show what the original quality verdicts described, so every statement about the images' quality was withdrawn and the image models are listed with reservations; only the measured timings and memory stand. No frozen bench.
title: Generative trials: French text-to-speech and school illustrations
